_comment: Per-unit hall-sensor calibration offsets, in stepper steps. Captured live
from the running wall before the #406 day-0 EEPROM erase, which is the one
value on a unit that is NOT reconstructible: the I2C address falls back to
the DIP switches and every counter legitimately restarts at zero, but an
offset only exists because somebody calibrated that drum by hand.
Restore with flashing/restore-unit-offsets.sh after the reflash.
Re-capture (values are served from the master's last probe, so refresh
first if a unit was recalibrated since):

rows.note: S3 leader, 16 units. Unit at address 15 was hall-dead at capture time; its offset is still the calibrated value and stays worth restoring after the sensor is repaired.
